title: Friends around the world … a gathering in Asia

body: I’m honored to be part of Mesa – a global table around which a fascinating group of people is gathering. It may just be that a few readers of my blog will feel a nudge to join us in Bangkok later this month – or that others will want to chip in some money to help with expenses for others to be able to attend. Check it out here: http://mesa-friends.org
